_comment: Written by the trading runs (9:30a / hourly / 3:30p ET). Never contains account numbers, broker IDs, or any account other than the sandbox.

account.note: Cash account. Proceeds settle T+1. Nothing settles tonight because nothing was sold, and the broker confirms unsettled funds at 0.00. 121.20 of the balance is 4 UPST as the broker marks it, 121.00 against the 30.25 bid, and 4.54 is settled cash. Total 125.74 against 127.50 at 15:22 ET - the 1.76 is the position marked down over the last quarter hour, not any movement of funds. Deployable stays 4.54, below one share of every name on the list, the cheapest of which is SOUN at 6.41. The account is fully committed and stays that way overnight, which is a consequence of the hold rather than a separate decision.

entryWatch.trigger: Reaction strong and still holding 30-60 min after the 8/5 open
entryWatch.why: Dead, and now closed by the bell rather than by argument. AMD is bid 483.60 at 15:37 ET against a 518.58 official close, about -6.7%, which is the weakest read of the day after 491.73, 486.55, 482.06, 488.79, 485.92, 487.15 and 487.22. Eight reads in a five-dollar band under the gap and the last one at the bottom of it: chop that ended heavy, not repair. The trigger asked for strength holding 30-60 minutes after the open and there is no session left for it to be tested in. This setup does not carry forward - a day-2 read on the 8/6 open is a new setup with a new trigger, not this one resumed.

entryWatch.trigger: Reaction strong but the leader is already extended
entryWatch.why: Conditional on a strong leader, and the leader closed at -6.7%. The condition never came near being met and the list has now gone fully red: UPST lost the last green on it in the final half hour and is bid 30.25 against a 30.32 close, about -0.2%. SMCI, the name this read pointed at, is bid 30.75, about -3.0%, one of the weakest on the list rather than a laggard due to catch up. Dead on the leader, dead on the 4.54 deployable, and dead on the clock.

entryWatch.trigger: A pullback that holds on 8/6 or 8/7, not today's reaction bar
entryWatch.why: Dead as an entry because the account is already long the name - a 13:34:59 ET directed fill bought 4 UPST at a 31.09 average, which is the reaction-day entry this setup existed to wait past. Adding on an 8/6 pullback would be averaging down, which docs/RULES.md lists under 'does not fit', and there is 4.54 to do it with in any case. The pullback the setup wanted has arrived as a bleed instead: bid 30.25 at 15:37 ET, extending the day to 33.81 after-hours, 32.23 open, 32.36, 32.05, 31.63, 31.26, 30.84, 30.73, 30.25 - nine reads, six consecutively lower. Last hour recorded the -0.11 step as a fact and warned against reading a turn into it. That was the right caution: this step is -0.48, the largest of the day. The entry now sits 0.84 above the bid.

entryWatch.trigger: Leader gapped down, most of the list red, only catalyst is a reaction-day spike
entryWatch.why: The branch the open resolved to and held for four hours, ended at 13:34:59 ET by a directed fill rather than by the tape. Marked dead because the account is not flat and a board describing itself as standing aside while holding 4 UPST would contradict its own exit panel. What the branch was worth, recorded now that the session is over: the reaction-day spike it declined to buy opened at a 32.23 bid and closes near 30.25. It did not fail, it was overtaken. The entry question does not reopen until the account has settled cash, and nothing settles tonight because nothing was sold.

candidatesAsOf: 2026-08-05 15:37 ET, live session bids read by the pre-close run. The Last column is the official 8/4 settled close.
candidatesNote: Bids are live and quoted as bids, never marks. This is the final read of the session and it is not an entry list: deployable settled cash is 4.54, below a single share of every name on it, and the pre-close slot does not open positions in the last thirty minutes in any case. All nine names are red into the close - UPST gave up the last green on the list in the final half hour. The one that matters is the held one, and it leaked a ninth read to a 30.25 bid, 0.84 below the 31.09 the position was filled at, with the step down this hour the largest of the day rather than the smallest. No level is hit. The four names printing tonight stay no-fly and none of them is held, so this run inherited no 3:55p flatten obligation and created none.

candidates.note: Reported. Bid 483.60, about -6.7%, the weakest read of the day. Sequence 491.73, 486.55, 482.06, 488.79, 485.92, 487.15, 487.22, 483.60 - eight reads in a five-dollar band under the gap, ending at the low end of it. Chop that closed heavy. Dead for today.

Held, and held deliberately into 8/6. The account is long 4 at a 31.09 average from a 13:34:59 directed fill. Bid 30.25, about -0.2% on the day and 0.84 under the entry, so the position is -2.70%. Ninth read, sixth consecutively lower, and the step was -0.48 against -0.11 the hour before, so last hour's deceleration did not hold. Target 37.31 is 23.3% up, stop 28.60 is 5.4% down, neither hit. Already reported on 8/4, so the overnight carries no earnings risk.
Reports tonight. Not held, so nothing to flatten. Bid 40.38, about -3.2%, softening into the print from -2.9%.
Reports tonight. Not held. Bid 9.40, about -0.9%, flat against the last read.
Reports tonight. Not held. Bid 7.75, about -2.8%, softening from -2.4%.
Reports tonight. Not held. Bid 6.41, about -1.5%. The cheapest name on the list and still above the 4.54 the account could pay.
Earnings 8/6 after the close, verified on the broker calendar, so the window closes 8/6 3:55p. Bid 11.40, about -3.0%. No catalyst before the print.

Earnings 8/7 before the open, verified on the broker calendar. A BMO print gaps past every stop, so the window closes on the 8/6 close. Bid 43.20, about -0.3% - four reads either side of unchanged all day.
Earnings 8/11 after the close. Bid 30.75, about -3.0%, among the weakest on the list. 8/11 is also where the UPST time stop lands, so both dates want watching in the same week.
